meta.name: Nashik District Agricultural Macro-Zones
meta.disclaimer: Zone definitions, rainfall bands, and taluka coordinates are INITIAL DOMAIN ASSUMPTIONS for prototyping. They are not verified against official gazetteer or ICAR agro-ecological zoning. Taluka coordinates are approximate centroids suitable only for district-level weather lookups.

sources.label: Initial domain assumption (Phase 0) - pending validation against Maharashtra State Agriculture Department / ICAR AER zoning

zones.name: Heavy Rainfall Belt
zones.description: Western Ghats influenced belt with very high monsoon rainfall, high humidity and hilly terrain.

characteristics.terrain: Hilly, forested Western Ghats escarpment with valley terraces

notes: ASSUMED rainfall band; needs validation against IMD district normals.
Taluka list per project brief Phase 0 scope.

zones.name: Central / Irrigated Belt
zones.description: Godavari basin plain with moderate rainfall, black and loamy soils, widespread well and canal irrigation supporting horticulture.
notes: ASSUMED rainfall band; Chandwad is drier than other central-belt talukas and may belong closer to the eastern belt in future revisions.
Grapes/onion dominance reflects Nashik's known horticulture profile but needs citation.

zones.name: Arid / Eastern Belt
zones.description: Drier eastern plain with lower rainfall, higher summer temperatures and constrained water availability.
notes: ASSUMED rainfall band; needs validation against IMD normals.
Drought-risk framing follows the project brief, not yet a cited climatology.
